concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 (measure correlation coefficient between Recommendation_Diversity and Learner_Diversity against the null hypothesis) has no corresponding task or unit test in tasks.md. Add a task (e.g., T060) to compute and verify the correlation coefficient and its p‑value.

Success Criterion SC-003 (false‑positive rate of the residual permutation test) is not explicitly covered by any task or test. Introduce a task (e.g., T061) that validates the permutation‑test false‑positive rate against the α=0.05 threshold.
Success Criterion SC-004 (VIF < 5.0) lacks a dedicated task or test asserting that the VIF threshold is enforced. Add a task (e.g., T062) with a unit test that fails if any VIF exceeds 5.0.

Success Criterion SC-005 (pipeline runtime < 6 h) is only warned about in T035; there is no test that asserts the runtime stays within the GitHub Actions free‑tier limit. Create a task (e.g., T063) that measures total execution time and fails if it exceeds 6 hours.

The implementation plan references two contract files (dataset.schema.yaml, output.schema.yaml) but there is no task that validates these contracts against generated artifacts (e.g., schema compliance tests). Add a contract‑validation task (e.g., T064) with associated unit tests.
